_comment: DESIGN.md §4. Lane geometry. Not one of the seven files listed in §16 - added because §4 numbers must not be hardcoded either. Tile space: y=0 is the top of the build grid, monsters spawn at negative y, the fortress sits below y=depth.
_decided: §4.2 was OPEN. Answered: units DO block movement. Monsters steer around occupied tiles (src/sim/grid.ts, steering.ts) and fall back to attacking whatever is nearest when fully boxed in.
_radiusNote: Body radius in tiles, used for entity-vs-entity separation - two of the same kind never come closer than the sum of their radii. Matches the drawn size, so what you see is what collides. Tile occupancy still governs monster-vs-unit, which is a wall rather than a crowd.
_pathNote: Cells per tile for the Dijkstra flow field. 4 gives quarter-tile cells, which is finer than a body is wide (0.68) - at one cell per tile, 'blocked' and 'clear' are the only answers and clearance cannot be represented at all. Raising it sharpens routing and costs a linear amount more per sweep.
